purrge.action.busy: Purrge was already in the middle of a scan, so it was left to finish.
purrge.action.gone: {0} is not there any more, so there was nothing to look in.
purrge.action.scan: Look for duplicates in its folder
purrge.action.scan.hint: Walks the folder the event was about, or the folder of the file it was about, and answers with how many sets and copies it found.
purrge.action.unknown: Purrge does not know how to “{0}”.
purrge.compare.depth: {0} of {1} were read in full; the rest were settled by size and date.
purrge.compare.empty: Pick the folder the copy was made from and the folder it lives in, then press Compare. Everything in the source is looked for in the copy; sizes are compared first, then content, so most files are settled without being read in full.
purrge.compare.good: The copy is complete and identical.
purrge.compare.readonly: Compare only reads. It never copies, deletes or touches a date, on purpose: the moment it fixed what it found it would be a backup tool with all of a backup tool's failure modes. Fix things with the tool that made the copy.
purrge.compare.start: Pick a source and a copy, then compare. Nothing is written to either.
purrge.compare.summary: {0} files, {1} · {2} missing · {3} stale · {4} different · {5} only in the copy
purrge.copies.none: None of the {0} has another copy on its drive.
purrge.copies.some: {0} of {1} have another copy; the sets are listed.
purrge.copy.hint: where the copy is supposed to be
purrge.description: Finds files with identical content anywhere on the machine, groups them, and clears out the copies you do not want.
purrge.empty: Pick a folder on the left and press Scan. Files are grouped by size first, then by content hash, so only real matches are read in full.
purrge.folderpick: PICK A FOLDER, THEN SAY WHICH SIDE IT IS
purrge.hint.created: Copying sets a new created time, so the copy looks newer than the original.
purrge.hint.modified: Copying usually preserves the modified time, so the original and its copies often match here.
purrge.lookalike.empty: Nothing yet. Exact copies are the Duplicates tab's; this finds the same picture saved differently.
purrge.lookalike.failed: {0} did not go to the Recycle Bin: {1}
purrge.lookalike.found: {0} groups; the copies not kept take up {1}. Each one is a guess: look before binning.
purrge.lookalike.grouped: Look alike, not the same bytes
purrge.lookalike.none: Nothing looks alike here at this closeness.
purrge.lookalike.nothing: Pick a picture in a group to see it next to the one kept.
purrge.lookalike.recycle: Send this one to the Recycle Bin
purrge.lookalike.recycled: {0} is in the Recycle Bin; {1} stays.
purrge.lookalike.rule: Only one at a time, and only with both on screen: a look-alike is a guess, and two pages of one comic can look as close as two copies of one page.
purrge.lookalike.start: Pictures that look the same without being the same bytes: resized, re-encoded, converted. Pick a folder and find them.
purrge.nopreview: No inline preview for this file type
purrge.pending: Either keep button removes {0} file(s) to the Recycle Bin.
purrge.records.recycled: sent a copy to the Recycle Bin
purrge.sanity: Matches are byte-identical, so the preview is a sanity check rather than proof. Every removal goes to the Recycle Bin.
purrge.source.hint: the folder the copy was made from
purrge.status.removed: {0}: {1} file(s) sent to the Recycle Bin.
purrge.status.start: Pick a folder on the left, then scan.
purrge.trust.hint: A copy with the same size and modified time is taken as identical without being read. Fast, and what most backup tools assume. Off, both files are read, which is the only way to catch a copy that went bad without its date changing.
